final_message:
The yen receipt test passes now, and `npm test` reports 18 of 18 passing.

**Cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` always divides by 100. Yen has no minor unit, so ¥500 was printed as ¥5.00 instead of ¥500.

**Fix:** I changed `src/payments/receipt.js` so JPY receipts print the amount in whole yen. Other currencies still go through `formatMoney`. The diff is one file, `src/payments/receipt.js`.

**Not fixed at the root:** `src/utils/money.js` has the same bug, and it is shared by invoices (`src/invoices/render.js`) and the cart total (`src/cart/total.js`). Those still show JPY amounts divided by 100. A fence rule ("this task only touches src/payments") blocked my edit to that file, so I left it alone. If you lift the fence for `src/utils/money.js`, the root fix is to make `formatMoney` treat JPY as zero-decimal. Then the receipt special case can be removed.
